description: Create or update many labels on a branch in one call (batched automatically, with no client-side size limit). Pass labels as an array of { key, values?, status?, tags?, context? }. Returns counts of created and updated labels plus a failed list of any individual items the server rejected (for example, an unknown language on one item). Use this instead of repeated upsert_label calls when writing more than a couple of keys, and give every new key its `context` (description, plus charLimit/location when known). Writes to the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

labels.description: The labels to create or update (at least one).

context.description: Translator context (developer role or higher). AI translation and the QA length check use it.

charLimit.description: Maximum length of every translation. Set it only when the UI clearly limits the length.

description.description: Which UI element this is and where it appears, e.g. "Submit button of the checkout payment form".

doNotTranslate.description: true when the text must stay the same in every language (a product name, brand or code): AI translation then copies the source text instead of translating it. false clears it.

location.description: Where the string is used, as "path:line".

name: upsert_labels
title: Create or Update Labels (Batch)
